items.author: echosaefir.com.mx
items.context: Just saw the System Shock games on sale on Steam and said "Sure, why the fuck not?". I already own the Bioshock games, though I've not got around to playing them yet. I also know these games are really hard. But I'm in the mood for Sci-Fi horror, and this seems like a neat investment.
items.text: Good pick for a sci-fi horror mood. The System Shock remake lets you set difficulty separately for combat, puzzles and cyberspace, so it's easier to tune than its reputation suggests.
items.verify: Проверьте на странице игры в Steam: у ремейка System Shock отдельные настройки сложности (бой, головоломки, киберпространство).

items.author: ratbatserd.bsky.social
items.context: my thought process is basically "oh new bethesda game? oh it's new? so no active passionate modding community has had a chance to make it worth while? cool, ill come back in a few years i guess"
items.text: Waiting for the mod scene is a fair call. Big open games usually get a lot better a year or two in, once patches and community fixes pile up.
